mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 61 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall under a full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will cool down to 53 degrees with no rain predicted.
City officials are reviewing the 2027 budget and upcoming development plans, including a final plat for Ardent Glen and site plans for Milky Way, set to be reviewed on November 4.
Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company, or visit the Dane County Farmers Market, followed by yoga on Sunday and trivia starting Monday.
Regarding a report from Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after dangerous driving was reported; no injuries were sustained.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle. The store is currently open but closing soon in 23 minutes, so make sure to get your order in before they close for the night.
